findings.title: The required joint statistical confidence event is replaced by five marginal events
findings.contract: DATA_ANALYSIS_CONTRACTS.md: Push the same joint statistical event and deterministic error body through full and reduced adapters; task target is a joint radiation/shear confidence image.
findings.defect: Each STF coordinate receives its own 0.95 quantile, and the output adds that marginal radius to deterministic support. There is no common calibrated vector event or joint coverage result. Reusing the same draws preserves correlations in the samples but does not make five separate 95% intervals a 95% joint event.

counterexample.method: full and independently reconstructed common carrier

findings.risk: The exported 300-row total-width table cannot serve as the contracted simultaneous shear confidence image. Directionwise marginal diagnostics remain valid at their stated finite oracle scope.
findings.minimal_fix: Define one calibrated vector/input-law event under the retained correlated R36 law, propagate that same event and shared physical disk through the compared adapters, report its actual simultaneous coverage and directional widths, and distinguish it from the existing marginal diagnostics. Account for operator variation on that event or explicitly retain a fixed-operator sensitivity layer separately. Add a regression that detects the 3389/4096 joint-coverage counterexample.

findings.title: The gain-only baseline is an eleven-component H4-dropped closure, not the Thomson gain carrier
findings.contract: The required comparison includes the MF02 cold-electron Thomson gain and actual compression/cost ranks under the same physical target; GOAL1_MORPHOLOGY.md defines M=rho I/3-pi/2+P_star+i A_star.
findings.defect: The code keeps rho, all five pi coordinates and all five P_star coordinates separately, while dropping H4 only from L. At V=0 the actual Thomson gain contains rho and -pi/2+P_star, with rank 6. Independent angular-kernel SVD gives rank 11 for the implemented reduction, while output reports 9 components. Generic 23/20 source ranks do not describe the actual fixed-polarization experiment, whose full angular kernel has rank 15.
findings.risk: The stated gain-only bias and cost comparison attributes results to a compression that the implementation does not perform. The same-gain counterexample proves the reported adapter depends on information outside the gain.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain the current calculation under its accurate H4-dropped rho/pi/P_star label and cost, and supply the required true gain-only comparison using only M with an explicit closure or an identified-set/nullspace response for the missing target information. Record generic source rank, actual fixed-profile angular-kernel rank and measured storage/cost separately. Add the positive same-M pair as a regression; a genuinely M-only estimator must be invariant on that fibre, or expose the ambiguity in its identified set.
